query: Hi there, I just bought that new scratch-resistant phone case with the shockproof certification last week, and now I can't get any internet on my phone at all when I'm traveling abroad. I've checked and airplane mode is turned on, my network preference is acting up, my VPN isn't working right, data saver mode is on, and I have roaming turned off, can you help me figure out what's going wrong?
